data.name: Manhal
data.gender_notes: Manhal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'n-h-l', meaning 'to rest', 'to be at peace'. In Islamic context, Manhal refers to a place of peace, refuge, and shelter, often symbolizing the eternal abode in Paradise. The name Manhal carries the meaning “Resting place, shelter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manhal usually hope their child will grow to embody resting place, shelter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign of Allah's protection and provision.
data.etymology: Manhal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resting place, shelter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manhal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
